name: sidetone
description: Tells the Sidetone hub which terminal you are in, so the Claude Code session running there gets the focus, types Escape into a session's terminal when you stop it with the cancel key, types /clear there when you tell a session by voice to clear the chat, brings the terminal of the session in focus to the front when you ask for it, and opens a terminal with a new Claude Code session or ends one with the new-session and end keys.
